final_message: Parsed the log file by reading each entry and its extra lines, filtering only ERROR and CRITICAL levels (case insensitive). Converted timestamps to UTC in the required format. Extracted the message after the service name on the first line. Extracted the last line of any traceback as the exception or null if none. Summed repeat counts from the "-- last message repeated N times --" lines following each entry. Counted total repeats per service. Created the JSON output file workspace/errors.json with the specified structure and conventions.

checks.name: rule_service_names
checks.detail: RULE: service names in the output are lower-case with '-' replaced by '_' (payment-service -> payment_service).

checks.name: rule_sorted_errors
checks.detail: RULE: `errors` is sorted by service, then by timestamp_utc, ascending.

checks.name: rule_schema_header
checks.detail: RULE: the top-level object has "schema_version": 2 and "generated_by": "log-triage".
